libraries.name: Barcodes
libraries.tagline: Barcodes for product labels, shipping labels, asset tags and inventory.
libraries.description: Barcodes for product labels, shipping labels, asset tags and inventory — Code 128, EAN-13, Code 39, Data Matrix, PDF417 — as PNG or SVG.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Make Barcode SVG
functions.description: Render a barcode as SVG markup — for print, a PDF report or a label sheet that must scale cleanly. Same symbologies as Make Barcode.

functions.name: Make Barcode
functions.description: Render a barcode as a PNG data URL for a product label, a shipping label, an asset tag, a pick list or an inventory sheet. The symbology is Code 128 unless given: code128, ean13, upca, code39, datamatrix, pdf417.

functions.name: Make EAN-13 Barcode
functions.description: Render a retail EAN-13 barcode (the 13-digit GS1 code on product packaging and price labels) as a PNG data URL.

libraries.name: Collections
libraries.tagline: Group by, sum by, count by, unique by, sort by, chunk, pivot, pick fields, top N — over lists of records.
libraries.description: Lists of records for dashboards, reports and imports — group orders by customer, sum a column, count by status, de-duplicate, sort by a field, split into batches, pivot rows into a table, keep only some fields, the top N.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Chunk
functions.description: Split a list into batches of a size — 100 rows per API call, 50 emails per send, 20 records per page.

functions.name: Count By
functions.description: How many records share each value of a field — tickets per status, orders per country, sign-ups per plan — as a list of { key, count } for a chart, a set of KPI tiles or a summary line.

functions.name: Group By
functions.description: Group a list of records by a field — orders by customer, tickets by status, expenses by month — as a list of { key, items } for a grouped table, a report section per group, or a per-group total.

functions.name: Pick Fields
functions.description: Keep only some fields of every record — the columns of an export, the fields an API may see, a lighter payload for a page. fields is a list or a comma-separated text.

functions.name: Pivot
functions.description: Pivot a list of records into a table: one row per value of rowField, one column per value of columnField, each cell the sum of valueField (or a count when valueField is empty) — sales by region and month, tickets by team and priority. Answers { columns, rows } ready for a table.

functions.name: Sort By
functions.description: Sort a list of records by a field, ascending unless direction is 'desc' — numbers as numbers, text alphabetically, empty values last; for a table before it is shown, a report, a pick list.

functions.name: Sum By
functions.description: Add up one field across a list of records — the total of an order's lines, the hours on a timesheet, the amount of a month's expenses.

functions.name: Top N
functions.description: The N records with the highest value of a field — best-selling products, largest invoices, most active users — for a leaderboard, a dashboard tile or a highlights email. n is 10 unless given.

functions.name: Unique By
functions.description: Remove duplicates from a list of records by a field, keeping the first of each — customers from a list of orders, distinct emails from an import, one row per SKU.

libraries.name: Crypto
libraries.tagline: Password hashing, signed tokens and unguessable ids — over bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken and uuid.
libraries.description: Hash and verify passwords with bcrypt, sign and verify JWTs, mint UUIDs for invite codes, reset links and idempotency keys — the platform's own library, over bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken and uuid.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Hash Password
functions.description: Hash a password with bcrypt (cost 10). Store the result; never the password.

functions.name: New Id
functions.description: A random UUID — for invite codes, reset links and idempotency keys.

functions.name: Sign Token
functions.description: Sign a payload into a JWT that expires in 1 hour. The secret comes from the caller.

functions.name: Verify Password
functions.description: Check a password against a stored bcrypt hash. Returns true or false.

functions.name: Verify Token
functions.description: Verify a JWT and return its payload. Fails when the signature or the expiry does not hold.

libraries.name: Data Formats
libraries.tagline: CSV, JSON and XML in and out — the price list a supplier emails, the order feed a warehouse sends.
libraries.description: The files and feeds other systems send and expect — parse a CSV a supplier emails into records, write records back as CSV, parse and write JSON, read a value at a path inside JSON, parse an XML feed or invoice into an object — over papaparse and xml2js.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Get JSON Path
functions.description: The value at a path inside an object or parsed JSON — 'order.items[0].sku', 'customer.address.city' — undefined when the path is not there; for reading a nested field out of a webhook payload or an API response without a code component.

functions.name: Make CSV
functions.description: CSV text from a list of records, with a header line — for a download, an email attachment, an export to a spreadsheet or another system.

functions.name: Make JSON
functions.description: JSON text from any value — for a request body, a file, a log line or a text column. indent is 0 for compact (the default) or 2 for readable.

functions.name: Parse CSV
functions.description: Records from CSV text — the price list a supplier emails, an export from another system, a bank statement — one object per row keyed by the header line, numbers as numbers. delimiter is detected unless given (',' ';' or a tab).

functions.name: Parse JSON
functions.description: An object from JSON text — a webhook body stored as text, a settings blob, a file a system sends. Malformed JSON fails the flow with the parser's message.

functions.name: Parse XML
functions.description: An object from XML text — an order feed from a warehouse, an invoice in UBL, a SOAP response, a sitemap — as plain nested objects with attributes as fields; repeated elements become a list, an element with both text and attributes keeps its text under '_'.

libraries.name: Dates & Time
libraries.tagline: Format, shift and compare dates — including working days.
libraries.description: Date arithmetic over date-fns: format for humans or for storage, add days and business days, measure the gap between two dates, and ask whether a deadline has passed. Every function takes and returns ISO-8601 text, which is what an Etyma parameter carries.
libraries.notes: Business-day functions skip weekends only. Public holidays vary by country and change every year, so they need a calendar the app supplies — see the Business Calendar library if you need them.

functions.name: Format Date
functions.description: Format an ISO date for a person, e.g. '9 Sep 2026'. Patterns are date-fns patterns: d MMM yyyy, EEEE, HH:mm.

functions.name: Format In Time Zone
functions.description: Render an instant in a named IANA zone — 'Asia/Singapore', 'Europe/London'. The one that matters when the server runs in UTC and the people using it do not.

functions.name: From Local Time
functions.description: Wall-clock text a person typed in their own zone, back to a real instant as canonical UTC. The conversion an appointment form always gets wrong.

functions.name: Add Days
functions.description: Shift an ISO date by a number of days and return ISO. Negative subtracts.

functions.name: Add Business Days
functions.description: Shift an ISO date by working days, skipping weekends. Use for 'due in 5 working days'.

functions.name: Days Between
functions.description: Whole calendar days from the first date to the second. Negative when the second is earlier.

functions.name: Business Days Between
functions.description: Working days from the first date to the second, weekends excluded. The usual measure of an SLA.

functions.name: Is Overdue
functions.description: True when the deadline is in the past. Pass the deadline and the moment to judge it against.

functions.name: Is Weekend
functions.description: True on a Saturday or Sunday. The cheap half of a working-day check.

functions.name: Age
functions.description: How long ago, in plain words: '3 days', '2 months'. For a Last updated column.

functions.name: Start Of Day
functions.description: Midnight at the start of the date, as ISO. Use as the lower bound of a whole-day range.

functions.name: End Of Month
functions.description: The last moment of the date's month, as ISO. Billing periods, reporting windows, retention cut-offs.

libraries.name: Insight
libraries.tagline: The five things every back-office screen needs on day one.
libraries.description: KPI tiles, sparklines, status pills, progress rings and empty states — built on the theme's own tokens, so they take on the colours of whatever app they are dropped into and read correctly in both light and dark.
libraries.notes: The sparkline and the ring are hand-drawn SVG because they belong inside a table cell. For a real chart with axes and a tooltip, recharts is on Etyma's allow-list — use it.

components.name: StatTile
components.description: A headline number with an optional delta that colours itself by direction. Set invertDelta for metrics where down is good.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: A trend line the size of a word, from a comma-separated series. Green when it ends above where it started.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.description: A status pill in one of five tones: neutral, info, success, warning, danger. A closed set on purpose.

components.name: ProgressRing
components.description: A circular proportion for places a bar will not fit — a row, a card corner, beside a label.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: What a list says when it is empty, with a way out. Accepts children for anything extra.

libraries.name: Math
libraries.tagline: Evaluate a formula written as text, round for money, sum, average, convert units.
libraries.description: Formulas a business user can edit, rounding for money, sums and averages, unit conversion — over mathjs.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Average
functions.description: The average (mean) of a list of numbers — ratings, response times, scores, monthly sales.

functions.name: Convert Unit
functions.description: Convert a quantity between units — inches to cm, kg to lb, km/h to m/s, litres to gallons, degC to degF — for shipping weights, product dimensions and metric/imperial forms.

functions.name: Evaluate Formula
functions.description: Evaluate a formula written as text — '(price * qty) * (1 - discount / 100)' — with named values; for a pricing rule, a quote, a commission, a tax, a calculator or any formula a business user edits without a release.

functions.name: Format Number
functions.description: Format a number as text with fixed decimals — for a price on a page, a total in a PDF, an amount in an email.

functions.name: Round
functions.description: Round a number to a number of decimal places — 2 for money and prices, 0 for a count or a quantity.

functions.name: Sum
functions.description: Add up a list of numbers — line totals into an invoice total, hours into a timesheet, quantities into a stock count.

libraries.name: QR Codes
libraries.tagline: QR codes for badges, tickets, check-in links and payment references.
libraries.description: QR codes for badges, tickets, check-in links and payment references — a PNG data URL or SVG from any text.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Make QR Code SVG
functions.description: Turn text or a URL into a QR code as SVG markup — for print, a PDF report, a label or a page that must scale without blur.

functions.name: Make QR Code
functions.description: Turn text or a URL into a QR code image as a PNG data URL — put it straight into an Image on a badge, an event ticket, a check-in poster, a payment slip, a boarding pass or an email. Scanning it opens the text.

components.name: QRCodeImage
components.description: Shows a QR code image made by Make QR Code, with a caption — on a badge, a ticket, a check-in card or a receipt.

libraries.name: Text
libraries.tagline: Slugs, truncation, title case, initials, masking, template filling, plurals and fuzzy matching.
libraries.description: Text for the parts of an app that people read — a URL slug from a title, a truncated preview, title case, initials for an avatar, a masked account number, HTML stripped from an email body, a message filled from a template, a plural, a similarity score for fuzzy matching.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Fill Template
functions.description: Fill a message template from an object: 'Hi {{name}}, your order {{order.id}} ships {{date}}' with { name, order, date } — for a notification, an SMS, a letter or a subject line. A name the object lacks becomes empty.

functions.name: Initials
functions.description: The initials of a person's name, up to three letters — for an avatar, a badge or a compact list of assignees.

functions.name: Mask
functions.description: Hide all but the last few characters of a card number, an account number, a phone number or an id — '•••• •••• •••• 4242' on a receipt, a statement or a profile page. visible is how many characters stay (4 unless given).

functions.name: Pluralize
functions.description: A count with its noun — '1 item', '3 items', '2 people' — for a summary line, a badge or a sentence in an email. plural is optional; the default adds an s.

functions.name: Similarity
functions.description: How alike two texts are, from 0 to 1 — for fuzzy matching a typed customer name against the records, spotting a duplicate product, or suggesting 'did you mean'. Case is ignored.

functions.name: Slugify
functions.description: Turn a title or a name into a URL slug — lower case, accents removed, words joined by hyphens: 'Café Menu 2026' becomes 'cafe-menu-2026'. For article URLs, product pages, file names and ids people can read.

functions.name: Strip HTML
functions.description: Plain text from HTML — an email body, a rich-text description or a scraped page, with tags removed and entities decoded — for a preview, a search index or a notification.

functions.name: Title Case
functions.description: Capitalise the first letter of every word — a product name, a heading, a person's name typed in lower case.

functions.name: Truncate
functions.description: Shorten text to a maximum length at a word boundary with an ellipsis — a preview of a description in a list, a card, a notification or a subject line.

libraries.name: Validation
libraries.tagline: Email, phone (E.164), URL, IBAN, card number, postcode and required fields — each with a reason.
libraries.description: Checks for what people type into forms and what arrives in files and API calls — email, phone in international E.164 format, URL, IBAN, card number, postcode by country, required fields — each answering { valid, reason } so a flow can show why.
libraries.author: Etyma

functions.name: Require Fields
functions.description: Are these fields present and non-empty on a record? fields is a list or a comma-separated text; answers { valid } or { valid: false, reason, missing } naming what is missing — a form before it is saved, a row before it is imported, a request before it is processed.

functions.name: Validate Card Number
functions.description: Is this a payment card number? Checks the length and the Luhn checksum and names the brand (visa, mastercard, amex, other); answers { valid, brand, last4 } or { valid: false, reason }. Never store the number — keep last4.

functions.name: Validate Email
functions.description: Is this an email address? Answers { valid, value } with the address in lower case, or { valid: false, reason } — for a sign-up form, a contact record, an invite, an imported list.

functions.name: Validate IBAN
functions.description: Is this an IBAN (the international bank account number on European payments)? Checks the shape and the mod-97 checksum; answers { valid, value, country } or { valid: false, reason } — a supplier's bank details, a refund, a payroll record.

functions.name: Validate Phone
functions.description: Is this a phone number, and what is it in international E.164 format? Answers { valid, e164, country, national, international } or { valid: false, reason } — for a customer's phone on an invoice, an SMS recipient, a contact form; country (US, GB, IN, SG, …) resolves a number typed without its country code.

functions.name: Validate Postcode
functions.description: Is this a postcode or ZIP code for the country? Knows US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IN, AU, SG, NL, JP and BR; answers { valid, value } or { valid: false, reason } — a shipping address, a billing address, a delivery form. A country without a rule accepts any non-empty value and says so.

functions.name: Validate URL
functions.description: Is this a web address (http or https)? Answers { valid, value, host } or { valid: false, reason } — a website on a supplier record, a link in a form, a webhook address.
